projection.caveat: Projection is a candidate water mask, not occlusion or visible-flow proof; inspect source images. Static control is the complement of the water mask, excluding a 3px boundary.

collision_screened_mask.method: Exact projected water triangles, pixel-center rays to planar water surface, rejecting foreground collision hits; source-image visual screening remains required for any render/collision mismatch.

scope: Unreviewed visual evidence only. No fluid, pump, audio or gameplay operation claim.
